description: Show a person how to do something on a website: an animated spotlight, a pointing arrow and a caption walk them through it step by step on the real page. Use when the user says "show me how…", "where do I…", "walk me through…", "guide me". Default mode "guided" points and explains — the person clicks/types themselves, and the tour advances on their click, their input, or navigation; pressing Next does the step's action for them (never into password/payment/one-time-code fields), and Back undoes a step that navigated. Mode "demo" performs the steps itself, slowly, with a visible cursor. Guided calls return waiting:true with a tourId when the person is still busy; call again with `resume` to keep waiting, or `stop` to end it. Tours always run where the person can see them: a headless session is reopened in a visible browser first (same page, cookies and localStorage), and the call fails if no visible browser can open.

accent.description: CSS colour for the spotlight, arrow and buttons (default violet).

mode.description: guided (default): point and explain, the person does each step. demo: Squire does the steps itself, slowly, with a visible cursor. Demo never types into password/payment fields — those steps wait for the person.

resume.description: Tour id from a previous call that returned waiting:true — keep waiting for the person.

steps.description: The tour, in order. Omit when using `resume` or `stop`.

action.description: What this step does. Demo mode performs it; guided mode leaves it to the person and uses it to pick a default `advance`.

advance.description: Guided: what moves on to the next step — the Next button (default), the person clicking the highlighted element, filling it in, or the page navigating. Defaults from `action`: click→click, fill/type/select→input.

readMs.description: Demo: ms to hold the step on screen before Squire performs it (default 5000).

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to spotlight (`xpath=…` / `text=…` prefixes also work). Omit for a caption-only step.

text.description: What to tell the person at this step — one idea, plain words.

value.description: Text for fill/type, option value for select (demo mode).

visual.description: Visible label or position hint ("Sign in", "close X top right") to ground the spotlight via OCR/vision when the DOM has nothing (canvas, PDF viewers).

stop.description: Tour id to end now; removes the overlay.

tab.description: Stable tab id (from playwright_list_tabs) to present on. Omit for the active tab. The tab is brought to the front.

waitSeconds.description: Guided: how long this call waits for the person before returning waiting:true (default 120). The overlay stays up meanwhile.

name: playwright_present
